Noah (AE): Riverbank wants a concise POC to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, response diffs, pricing delta, and SQ handoff. Can eng/security split tasks?
Eli (ML Eng): I can run diff jobs. Need a 48h redacted prompt sample and whether they stream. Also ask for median token lengths.
Noah (AE): They stream; peak concurrent ~450. I'll request sample + traffic profile.
Sana (Solutions Eng): POC plan: 1) quick adapter to translate CompetitorX payloads to Redwood, 2) replay at low rate, 3) golden prompt suite + comparator. I can scaffold the proxy.
Sana (Solutions Eng): adapter example:
```
POST /proxy -> map body.input -> {"input": ..., "model": "redwood-small", "temperature": 0}
```
Eli (ML Eng): For parity use temperature=0, top_p=0.0 and record tokenizer outputs. CompetitorX may normalize newlines differently.
Lena (Product): For pricing delta I need sequence histograms. Include hosted vs dedicated scenarios and note INT8/quantization benefits.
Diego (Security): I'll start the SQ. Need answers for retention, SSO (SAML), KMS options, and egress IP ranges. If they require BYOK, Private can cover it.
deploy-bot: replay job queued by Sana - job_id=11007 - ETA 10m.
Noah (AE): Next steps: 1) Riverbank to upload sample + SQ, 2) Sana to deploy adapter + replay, 3) Diego to draft SQ answers, 4) Eli + Lena to run parity and cost model. Sync in 6 business days. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Eli (ML Eng): ack
Sana (Solutions Eng): ack
Lena (Product): ack
Diego (Security): ack
Noah (AE): thanks — I'll send calendar invite and share drive link.
